entities.name: Jaguar Tooth
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth is non-persistent malware that targets Cisco IOS routers

entities.name: CVE-2017-6742
entities.evidence: It is deployed and executed via exploitation of the patched Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) vulnerability CVE-2017-6742

entities.name: Modify Authentication Process
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth patches two authentication functions to grant access to local accounts for Telnet and physical sessions

entities.name: Modify System Image: Patch System Image
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth patches the system image in memory to enable a user authentication bypass

entities.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth is deployed via an SNMP exploit which grants remote code execution

entities.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol: Exfiltration Over Unencrypted Non-C2 Protocol
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth exfiltrates collected device information over TFTP

entities.name: Automated Exfiltration
entities.evidence: T1020 Automated Exfiltration Jaguar Tooth contains a hard

entities.name: Automated Collection
entities.evidence: T1119 Automated Collection Jaguar Tooth contains a hard

entities.name: Data from Configuration Repository: Network Device Configuration Dump
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth utilises a Cisco IOS CLI command to dump the current device running configuration

entities.name: Remote System Discovery
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth performs remote system discovery by utilising Cisco IOS CLI commands

entities.name: File and Directory Discovery
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth enumerates the local flash filesystem by utilising a Cisco IOS CLI command

entities.name: System Network Configuration Discovery
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth utilises several Cisco IOS CLI commands to discover the system network configuration

entities.name: System Information Discovery
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth discovers system information such as interfaces and software versioning

entities.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Network Device CLI
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth executes the following shortened Cisco IOS CLI and Tcl commands
